name: Checkout Field Editor (Checkout Manager) for WooCommerce – Lumo WP
author: Lumowp

sections.description:
Customize your WooCommerce checkout fields effortlessly with a visual drag-and-drop builder.

Lumo Checkout Form Builder Lite is a professional, lightweight tool designed for store managers who need full control over their WooCommerce checkout experience. The default WooCommerce checkout rarely fits every store perfectly. With this plugin, you can easily add, rename, reorder, or hide billing, shipping, and additional fields without touching a single line of code.

Whether you need to shorten your checkout for better conversion rates or collect specific information from your customers, Lumo Checkout Form Builder gives you a simple, fast, and completely visual admin panel to make it happen.

Why choose Lumo Checkout Form Builder?

  • Visual Drag & Drop: Rearrange your checkout fields instantly. Just drag the field you want and drop it where you need it.
  • Full Field Control: Add new fields, rename existing labels, change placeholder text, and toggle whether a field is required or optional.
  • Clean Up Your Checkout: Hide unnecessary default WooCommerce fields to create a frictionless, high-converting checkout flow.
  • Essential Field Types: Supports text, email, phone, textarea, select (dropdowns), checkbox, and radio buttons.
  • Seamless Integration: Custom field values are automatically displayed on the WooCommerce order screen and included in order emails.
  • Future-Proof: Fully compatible with the classic WooCommerce checkout, the new WooCommerce Checkout Block, and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Privacy First: This plugin runs entirely on your server and does not send checkout data to any external service.

Unlock Ultimate Power with the Pro Edition

While this free Lite edition gives you everything you need to organize a standard checkout, growing stores often require more advanced data collection and logic.

The Full Edition takes your checkout customization to the next level by adding:

  • Advanced Field Types: File uploads, date and time pickers, number fields, password fields, hidden fields, multiselect dropdowns, and a group of checkboxes.
  • Conditional Logic: Show or hide specific checkout fields dynamically based on what the customer selects in other fields.
  • Product Fields: Ask an extra question only when that product is in the cart. Other orders never see it.
  • Seamless Upgrade: Both editions store fields in the exact same database structure. You can upgrade from Lite to Pro instantly without losing your work or rebuilding your forms.

Ready to build the perfect high-converting checkout?
👉 Upgrade to Lumo Advanced WooCommerce Checkout Field Editor Pro
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload this plugin through Plugins > Add New, or copy the folder to /wp-content/plugins/, then activate it.
  3. Open Lumo WP > Checkout Form Builder Lite.
  4. Edit the fields and press Save Changes.
  5. Open the store checkout and confirm the form.
sections.faq:
Does this replace the WooCommerce checkout page?

No. WooCommerce still runs the checkout. This plugin changes the fields on that checkout: their order, labels, placeholders, required state, and whether they are shown. Open Lumo WP > Checkout Form Builder Lite, edit Billing Fields, Shipping Fields, or Additional Fields, then press Save Changes.

What can the free checkout field editor change?

The free edition edits billing, shipping, and additional checkout fields. You can drag fields into a new order, place a field on half a row or the full row, add a field, copy it, rename it, or delete it. You can also turn a field off so shoppers do not see it. Field types in this edition are text, email, phone, textarea, select, a single checkbox, and radio buttons.

Which field types are included for free, and which need the full edition?

Free field types are text, email, phone, textarea, select, checkbox, and radio. Select and radio fields include an options list. The full edition adds file upload, date, time, number, password, hidden fields, multi-select, and a group of checkboxes. Those extra types are not in this free plugin.

Can I hide Company, the second address line, or order notes?

Yes. Each field has a show/hide control. Turning it off removes that field from classic checkout and from the WooCommerce Checkout block. Country stays on the block, because WooCommerce uses it to load the rest of the address form. For the most complete control over every field, use the Create Classic Checkout Page button under General Settings.

Does this work with the Checkout block and High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. It works with classic checkout, created with the [woocommerce_checkout] shortcode, and with the WooCommerce Checkout block. Custom field values are stored as order meta, so they also work when High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) is enabled. WooCommerce 8.0 or newer is required.

Where do the customer’s extra answers appear?

Custom answers are saved on the WooCommerce order. On the order screen they appear in the Custom Checkout Fields box. The same values are added to WooCommerce order emails, in both HTML and plain text. Default WooCommerce fields, such as the normal order notes field, stay in their usual place.

Can I make a field required, change its label, or format the phone number?

Yes. Open a field and you can change its type, label, placeholder, default value, and whether it is required. Phone fields also accept a format such as 09##-###-####, where # means a digit. There is a separate option, Disable Auto-Save, for a field that should not be remembered between page refreshes. Use that for temporary or sensitive answers.

Can I show a field only for one product, or only after another answer?

Not in this free edition. Those are full-edition tools. A product field appears only when that product is in the cart, so other orders never see the question. A conditional rule shows a field only after a chosen answer. If the customer does not give that answer, the field stays off the form. See the Lumo Advanced WooCommerce Checkout Field Editor.

Can customers upload a file or choose a delivery date at checkout?

Not with this free plugin. File upload and date and time fields are part of the full edition. With file upload, the customer attaches a file during checkout and you open that file from the order screen. Date, time, number, password, hidden, multi-select, and grouped checkbox fields are also full-edition field types.

If I upgrade later, do I have to rebuild the checkout form?

No. Both editions store the checkout fields in the same place. Deactivate this free plugin, then activate the full edition. The fields you already saved stay in place. Keep only one of the two plugins active. You can also export the field setup as JSON from General Settings and import that file on another site.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • This free edition only includes the field tools it actually provides. File upload, extra field types, product fields and conditional rules are not part of this plugin.
  • Field settings are cleaned before they are saved, and checkout values are cleaned before they are stored.

1.2.0

  • Renamed to Lumo Checkout Form Builder Lite.
  • This free edition no longer lists field types it does not include, and it does not ask for a license key.

1.1.4

  • The Full Edition tab now shows a side-by-side checkout, so the extra tools are easy to see.

1.1.3

  • Added a Full Edition tab that explains product fields, file upload, extra field types and conditional rules.

1.1.1

  • Turning a field off in the editor now hides that default field on the checkout block as well as classic checkout. Country stays on the block, because WooCommerce needs it to load the address form.

1.0.0

  • Initial release. Drag and drop editor for billing, shipping and additional checkout fields, with the basic field types.
